text: As the Patriots look to secure their first win of 2026 against the Steelers in Sunday's 1 PM ET home opener at Gillette Stadium, the team will have to navigate some significant adversity: wide receiver A.J. Brown has been placed on injured reserve with a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1, sidelining him for at least four games, which means other receivers will need to step up in the chess match against Pittsburgh's defense and the blueprint that may be forming against Drake Maye and the Patriots' offense. Beyond football, Maye and his wife Ann Michael drew attention this week for their generosity toward education, funding the Amazon classroom wish lists for over 50 teachers and support specialists at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence, while Patriots owner Robert Kraft made headlines by having Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's Gillette Stadium shows, citing the artist's history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery. The injury report and practice participation data will be critical to monitor as New England tries to bounce back from its Week 1 loss and get on track heading into this crucial divisional matchup.
